risk_note: RV2, settlement (clawback + settlement records), no migration, no contract change, orders untouched (withdraw lane, model Claude Fable 5.1; orchestrator rulings D10-579, D10-753 ③, D10-755, D10-760, D10-762, D10-764, D10-774). Before this task a CREDITED order that received a new union settlement record on sync moved no money unless a rights record was waiting for the union (B2-04lb): a lower settlement amount was never taken back and 0 or a negative amount never clawed the order back. Now, in the order of 08 BR-FUND-01「R9 与 R9b 的判定」: R9 (refund increase, or a rights record) takes the new settlement amount as N_new (BR-FUND-08 ①); otherwise a new settlement record is R10 / BR-FUND-09: R8 through the existing apply when the positive part is 0 or the base goes > 0 → 0; the negative route posts SETTLE_ADJUST / SETTLE_DIFF `…:ADJ:{seq}` per beneficiary and platform on the sync transaction (deletion → BAD_DEBT; banned / deleted → the excess to the platform and the open obligation forfeited, closed_by R10; frozen / appealing / released → pending, an existing obligation kept or a deferred one opened by R10), moves the booked pair with a CAS and writes one SETTLE_NEGATIVE_DIFF history row; CREDITED stays. The positive route writes nothing (no voucher, booked pair unchanged, no candidate) and warns settle_adjust_positive_pending — the candidate and its approval are FU-SETTLE-ADJ-POSITIVE (funds); the same holds on the R9 path when the new amount is above the booked pair (D10-760 ①). All amounts come from @couli/domain planCommissionAdjustment (unchanged); the lock order stays order key → users rows → balance rows. 'A new deciding settlement record' is remembered by the settlement-record write entry per transaction object (module-level WeakMap; a replay inserts nothing, a rollback or redelivery runs on a new transaction, an API record beside a STATEMENT decides nothing). Real risks: a double posting (covered: uniq_key carries seq on the PG unique constraint; replay, redelivery after rollback and two concurrent identical reports give one posting), posting on the wrong direction (covered: equal base, zero base, positive then lower amount measured against the booked pair), a wrong beneficiary state (covered: deletion, banned after credit, held then banned / deleted, held then frozen / appealing / normal, no obligation, forfeited at credit, snapshot reserve_bp). Known and deferred, not in this task's paths: the in-app message for a negative adjustment (BR-FUND-09 细则) — FU-SETTLE-ADJ-NOTIFY (content; a TODO marks the write point); a waiting rights record with a negative difference that must settle an obligation still waits with an alert (B2-04lb unchanged, FU-RIGHTS-WAIT-ADJ-OBLIGATION); 'refund increased' is still read as refunded_quantity above its value at credit, so a later settlement record on such an order stays R9 (same money, CLAWBACK instead of SETTLE_ADJUST; money review S2, proposed FU-R9-REFUND-BASELINE). Frozen tests: the directories of the touched interfaces ran on the implementation tree through the local container slot — settle-diff-sync 36, clawback 45, settlement-records 41, deciding-settlement 12, rights-credit 26, rights 62, rights-answered-schema 6, rights-estimate 38, commission estimate-port 83, 349 green — and no frozen expectation had to change. Test-machine full verify not run (AWS runners disabled, D10-555; CI verify-int is the full verification, approvals 21); the red run and the implementation's runs of the rule tests were made in the local Docker container / host slot.
